summary: Banco Santander filed a 6-K announcing its intention to launch voluntary exchange tender offers in Brazil and the U.S. to acquire the ~10% minority stake in Santander Brazil. Consideration is newly issued Santander shares: 0.4056 per unit/ADS and 0.2028 per common/preferred share, representing a 15% premium and up to €1,908 million total. No minimum acceptance condition; not seeking delisting. Transaction is expected to be neutral to capital ratio. Watch for antitrust approvals and final offer documentation.
